declared_stale_records_created_by_this_p.why_not_fixed_here: B02 requires the status file to be an exact whole projection of a historical receipt belonging to another packet. It cannot express post-acceptance state without either falsifying its own projection or rewriting audited history. Reconciling it requires changing the validator invariant from 'no ADR is accepted' to 'acceptance matches the operator ledger', which is a separate packet with its own independent audit.
